stories.headline: US-Iran escalation threatens oil supply recovery, warns IEA
stories.summary: Tensions between the US and Iran have intensified following strikes on Iranian port cities, with Iran responding with additional attacks and regional powers exchanging threats of further retaliation. The International Energy Agency warns that continued escalation risks disrupting global oil supplies at a time when markets are still stabilizing from previous production losses.

stories.headline: Bodies found in cars as deadly Spain wildfire kills at least 12
stories.summary: A major wildfire in southern Spain has killed at least 12 people, with some victims found in their vehicles as they attempted to flee the advancing flames. The fire spreads during an intense heat wave that has raised temperatures across the region and complicated firefighting efforts.

stories.headline: Bayeux Tapestry arrives in UK for first time in 900 years under police guard
stories.summary: The 11th-century Bayeux Tapestry has arrived at the British Museum under heavy security, marking its first display outside France in nearly a millennium. The medieval embroidered cloth, which depicts the 1066 Norman conquest of England, will remain in the UK for a limited exhibition before returning to its permanent home in Normandy.

stories.headline: France cruise into semi-finals - could this be the best Les Bleus ever?
stories.summary: France defeats Morocco to advance to the World Cup semifinals, with their attacking players delivering a dominant performance. The team's depth and firepower raise questions about whether this squad could rank among the greatest French national teams in history.

stories.headline: Ebola death toll reaches 600, as new cases suspected in other parts of Congo
stories.summary: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has killed 600 people, with confirmed cases now exceeding 1,700 across multiple provinces. Health officials warn the epidemic has not yet peaked, as the virus continues spreading into previously unaffected areas despite containment efforts.

stories.headline: South Korea’s SK Hynix raises $26.5bn in record-breaking US IPO
stories.summary: SK Hynix, a South Korean memory chip manufacturer, raised $26.5 billion through a U.S. IPO, marking the second-largest stock offering in American history. The offering capitalizes on surging demand for semiconductor memory driven by artificial intelligence infrastructure investments.

stories.headline: India is becoming a shaping power
stories.summary: India is expanding its influence across the Indo-Pacific through strategic partnerships, securing landmark agreements with Australia on nuclear energy, defense, and uranium exports. These moves reflect India's growing role in shaping regional security dynamics alongside established powers like Japan and Australia.

stories.headline: EU threatens Meta with fines over 'addictive' Facebook and Instagram
stories.summary: The EU is threatening Meta with financial penalties if the company fails to remove design features in Facebook and Instagram that the regulator considers deliberately addictive and harmful to mental health. Meta has been given a deadline to modify its algorithmic feeds and other engagement-maximizing features or face substantial fines under European digital regulation rules.

stories.headline: Andy Burnham (Almost) Wins
stories.summary: Andy Burnham gains significant support among Labour lawmakers as a potential future prime minister, though the outcome remains uncertain. His bid reflects internal party positioning as Labour navigates its leadership direction amid broader public skepticism about various political figures.

stories.headline: At least 28 dead in China factory fire: state media
stories.summary: A fire at a shoe factory in eastern China kills at least 28 people, marking a significant industrial accident in the region. President Xi Jinping has ordered a full investigation into the incident, signaling high-level attention to workplace safety conditions.
